hero.title: Ohannes!
hero.description: It is very interesting of course, but for example, when you enter the site, the thing that attracts the most attention is the iridescent text on the top and the blue button below. The reason for this is that we can draw people's attention and focus to one place with design. This is exactly why we do not act according to our own will on websites and we are manipulated. Yes, life is very interesting, dear visitor, for example, a person can miss the smell of someone they love very much.
